༁ྃ:zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos spyod thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor sems nyid rang grol bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos spyod thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor sems nyid rang grol bzhugs so//

zab chos dgongs pa rang grol las/ sngon 'gro rang rgyud sbyong byed 'di bzhin byed na legs/ kye ma kyi hud skal ldan rigs kyi bu// ma rig gti mug dbang gis ma non par// brtson 'grus ngar bskyed da lta yar longs dang*// thog med dus nas da la thug gi bar// ma rig dbang gis nyal yun des chog gi /da ni ma nyal sgo gsum dge la 'bad// skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mi shes sam// de ring tsam yang rtag pa'i go skabs med// bsgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i dus la babs// da res gcig pu gtan bde bsgrub dus 'dir// snyoms las ngang la sdod pa'i dus ma yin// 'chi ba soms la sgrub pa mtha' ru skyol// tshe la long med 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyab// de tshe mi 'tsher gdeng zhig ma thob na// skyes bu khyod nyid gson pas ci zhig rung*// chos rnams bdag med stong zhing spros dang bral// sgyu ma smig rgyu rmi lam gzugs brnyan dang*// dri za'i grong khyer brag cha lta bur spyod// chu zla chu bur mig yor sprul pa sogs// shes bya sgyu ma'i dpe bcu de bzhin du// 'khor 'das chos rnams khyod kyis shes par gyis// chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba med pa ste// gnas med 'gag med 'gro 'ong med pa'o// dmigs med mtshan ma med cing bsam brjod bral// don de rtogs par bya ba'i dus la babs/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mo dhe wa bhyaḥ na mo ḍākki bhyaḥ kye ma kye ma mi rtag 'khor ba'i chos// thar med las kyi rgya mtsho dong ring 'dir// las kyis mnar ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byin gyis rlobs// ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams// bde ba 'dod phyir sdug bsngal las la spyod// thabs mi mkhas pa'i 'gro rnams snying re rje// nyon mongs las sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dod gzung 'dzin bcings pa'i btson ra 'dir// ri dwags rgyar tshud slar yang 'jug pa ltar// ma rig gti mug can rnams snying re rje// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par byin gyis rlobs// thar med las kyi grong khyer drug po 'dir// gcig nas gcig tu zo chu'i khyud mo bzhin// thar med 'khor ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje// rigs drug skye sgo chod par byin gyis rlobs// skye rga na dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal rnams// ci tsam mthong yang mi 'jigs snying bsran can// yengs ma lam la dal 'byor mi tshe zad// mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs// mi rtag blo gtad med par ma shes pas// da dung 'khor ba 'di la zhen cing chags// skyid 'dod ngang la mi tshe sdug gis 'da'// 'khor ba zhen pa log par byin gyis rlobs// snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag me chus 'jig

/bcud kyi sems can mi rtag lus sems 'bral// dbyar dgun ston dpyid nam zla dus mi rtag /skyo shas gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs// na ning da lo nam zla'i stod smad dang*// zhag dang nyin mtshan skad cig dus mi rtag /legs par bsam na rang nyid 'chi bas gtugs// bsgrub la snying rus nus par byin gyis rlobs// dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed dka' yang*// 'chi bdag nad kyis nye bar btab pa'i tshe// chos med 'gro rnams stong log snying re rje// long med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// kye ma kyi hud dkon mchog thugs rje can// rgyal ba khyed la brtse ba'i mthu mnga' bas// bdag sogs rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// da lta nyid du thar bar byin gyis rlobs// de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro ni/ khams gsum rigs drug mtha' yas sems can rnams// 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum du// rgyun chad med par 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// rkang gnyis gtso bo mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// phrin las mi bzad nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhi ba chags bral don dam bden pa'i chos// theg pa gsum gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i lam// bka' gter lung dang man ngag bstan bcos sogs// dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ma nor lam gnas tshogs mchog kun gyi zhing*// nyon mongs dri mas rab dben 'phags pa'i tshogs// byang sems nyan rang rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mchog /dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso// byin rlabs thugs rjes 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang*// 'gro ba'i don phyir zhi dang khro gar sprul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// chos nyid mkha' la thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'gro// dag pa'i gnas nas bde chen mchog stsol zhing*// dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad ma// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ye shes las grub mngon shes rdzu 'phrul can// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing*// bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad pa// dam can rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ye nas stong nyid spros dang bral ba la// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ka nas dag

/mnyam rdzogs klong yangs chen po'i rang bzhin la// 'dzin med blo 'das ngang du skyabs su mchi// lhun grub rang bzhin ye nas sku lnga'i bdag /dbyings rig stong gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du// rang rig 'od gsal rdo rje lu gu rgyud// rtog med rang gsal rjen par skyabs su mchi// ma 'gags rang rtsal kun khyab thugs rje can// shar grol 'gags med rig rtsal rol pa'i zer// rtog med ngang nas 'gro blo'i mun sel ba// dus gsum thog mtha' med par skyabs su mchi// de nas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa ni/ kye ma// chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med kyang*// de ltar ma rtogs sems can snying re rje// snying rje'i gnas rnams byang chub thob bya'i phyir// bdag gi sgo gsum dge la bskul bar bya// 'gro drug sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// bdag gcig ma yin 'gro kun don gyi phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par bya// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa'i nang*// rang gis rang bcings chos med snying re rje// snying rje'i gnas rnams bde la 'god bya'i phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par bya// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba sems can rnams// ye nas sangs rgyas rang bzhin yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid chen po ru// byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par bya// 'jig rten 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgyu ma bzhin// 'dus byas thams cad rtag pa ma yin te// ngo bo stong pa bdag med yin pa la// de ltar ma rtogs byis pa 'di dag rnams// rten 'brel bcu gnyis srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams// ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags pa rnams// sangs rgyas thob phyir bdag gi lus dang ngag /yid dang gsum po dge la bskul bar bya// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/mtha' yas 'gro ba sems can ji snyed pa// ma lus 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni// sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /kun kyang sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang ldan gyur cig /chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms gnas gyur cig /sdig sgrib sbyangs phyir yig brgya 'dren pa ni/ spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku// sku mdog shel 'dra'i thugs ka nas// zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun tshangs bug babs// bdag gi nyams chag sdig sgrib dag /bcom ldan dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis// bdag dang 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa'i// sdig sgrib sbyang phyir ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun// da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ sogs dang*/ bdag ni mi shes gti mug rmongs pa yis// dam tshig bsrung mtshams las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon po khyed kyis skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag sogs skyabs mdzod cig /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs bcas kun// ma lus byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag nyid kyang*// rdo rje sems dpa' deng 'dir 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la myur du 'khod par shog /rdo rje sems dpa' khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /de nas mchod pa'i maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi ma dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi rol rin chen lcags ri khor yug gyur// dbus su ri rgyal lhun po mchog rab nyid// rin chen sna lnga las grub lhun chags shing*// dbyibs legs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa la// gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho bdun gyis bskor// shar du lus 'phags lho ru 'dzam bu gling*// nub tu ba glang spyod kyi gling gis brgyan// byang du sgra mi snyan gyi gling chen la// lus dang lus 'phags rnga yab rnga yab gzhan// g.yo ldan lam mchog 'gro dang sgra mi snyan// sgra mi snyan gyi zla dang gling phran brgyad// nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan dus me dang*// lha mi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'di// bla ma dkon mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang snod bcud stong gsum gzhal yas su// ri rab gling bcas rdul snyed mchod sprin gtibs// lha mi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'di// bla ma dkon mchog sprul sku'i zhing du 'bul// thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang*// 'gro kun sprul sku'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i gzhal yas su// dbang po rnam lnga bkrag dang mdangs kyis brgyan// khams dang skye mched yongs su dag pa 'di// bla ma dkon mchog longs sku'i zhing du 'bul// thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang*// 'gro kun longs sku'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sems nyid chos sku dag pa'i gzhal yas su// dmigs med stong gsal 'dzin med ngang du gnas// gdod nas dag pa'i gnyug ma ye shes 'di// bla ma dkon mchog chos sku'i zhing du 'bul// thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang*// 'gro kun chos sku'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyes byed maṇḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rtogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro kun sgrol bar shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍākki ni ratna maṇḍal putstsha me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang*// drug pa'i bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// 'dren pa'i gtso bo thugs mchog rdo rje sems// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sprul pa'i skyes mchog rig 'dzin dga' rab dang*// rgyal ba'i sras mchog gu ru shrī seng*// rdo rje'i sku brnyes 'chi med padma 'byung*// gsang sngags snod ldan mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma// rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zab gter mnga' bdag karma gling pa dang*// thugs kyi sras mchog chos rje'i mtshan can dang*// snyigs dus 'gro mgon surya tsand+ra'i zhabs// gang zag snyan brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rim gnyis don rtogs nam mkha' rgyal mtsho dang*// bden gnyis mngon gyur bsod nams 'od zer dang*// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pun+ye shrī rje// don gnyis lhun grub byang chub gling pa'i zhabs// mkhyen pa gnyis ldan bsod nams chos skyong dang*// sku gsum mngon gyur sna tshogs rang grol ba// srid gsum mgon po'i thugs sras kun dga' grags// rtsa gsum ngo bo bstan 'dzin grags pa dang*// theg gsum mdzod 'dzin mdo sngags bstan 'dzin zhabs// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug phrin las lhun grub dang*// snang bzhi mthar phyin o rgyan gter bdag gling*// dbang bzhi'i don rtogs lo chen dharma shrī// mtha' bzhi rnam grol 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang*// sku lnga lhun grub ratna bi dza dang*// ye shes lnga ldan theg mchog bstan 'dzin rje// rigs lnga'i gtso mchog kun grol rnam par rgyal// lnga bdo'i 'gro mgon nges don bstan 'dzin bzang*// chos nyid don rtogs mi bskyod rdo rje dang*// mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje 'chi med mgon// rigs kun bdag nyid rdo rje snying po rtsal// rig stong ngo sprod rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// snang stong dbyer med yi dam zhi khro dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gang la gang 'dul bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// khyod kyi bstan pa shin tu nyams dma' na// dus 'dir skyes pa'i rnal 'byor yid pham pas// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol// smre sngags gdung ba'i nga ros khyod 'bod na// sngon gyi dam bca' gnyen po da dgongs la// mkha' dbyings klong nas mtshan dpe'i zhal bstan 'tshal// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol// grags stong tshangs pa'i gsung gi sgra sgrogs nas// khyed kyi thugs mdzod gter gyi sgo phyes la// mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'od zer rab bkyes nas// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol// dus mtha'i 'gro rnams ma lus da sgrol cig

/rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu bo da bskur cig /nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rgyud bzhi da khrol cig /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol// bde gshegs sku bzhi'i 'bras bu da stsol cig /mtha' yas pha ma khams gsum sems can rnams// ma lus 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol// de nas dbang bzhi zhu ba'i dgongs pa ni/ bla ma yab yum spyi gtsug nas// oṃ dkar 'od zer dang bcas pa// bdag gi smin mtshams mdzod spur babs// bum dbang thob nas lus sgrib dag /sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// bla ma yab yum mgrin pa nas// āḥdamar 'od zer dang bcas pa// bdag gi lce yi dbang por babs// gsang dbang thob nas ngag sgrib dag /gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// bla ma yab yum thugs ka nas// hūm̐ mthing 'od zer dang bcas pa// bdag gi snying gi dkyil du babs// ye shes dbang thob yid sgrib dag /thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// bla ma yab yum lte ba nas// hrīḥyig 'od zer dang bcas pa// bdag gi lte ba'i dkyil du babs// sgo gsum tha dad 'dzin sgrib dag /dbyer med lhan skyes dbang bzhi thob// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying khar padma'i ze'u 'bru la// 'bral ba med par rtag par bzhugs nas kyang*// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// dpal ldan bla ma khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /'di dag zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi sngon 'gro rang rgyud sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs la sbyar yang rung zhing*/ bla med theg pa chen po'i chos spyod/ gter ston karma gling pa'i sras kyi thu bo chos rje gling pas zhal gdams gu ru surya tsand+ra rasmis yi ger bkod pa'o//
